svg.title: Postmortem Autopilot — evidence-grounded incident postmortems
svg.desc: Evidence plane (deterministic collectors into a Neo4j temporal graph) feeds a fenced LLM reasoning plane (LangGraph analyst and writer), whose draft is checked by a deterministic validator; failures loop back with feedback.

text.tspan: Rebuilds an incident timeline from logs, alerts, deploys
and commits, then writes a postmortem where
source event, or it doesn't ship. The LLM is fenced
